messages: Carla: Heads-up — Docusaurus build for /guides failing on CI. Linkcheck shows an anchor-not-found and an MDX admonition parse error. Error excerpt below: Carla: ``` Error: MDXParseError: Unexpected token at docs/guides/setup.mdx: line 42 Linkcheck: broken link ../ops/cache#warm-start -> anchor not found ``` deploy-bot: Build #4821 failed — linkcheck errors (2). :warning: Ben: Which pages exactly? can you paste the small stack or lines around the issue? Carla: It points to docs/guides/setup.mdx and docs/ops/cache.mdx. In setup.mdx there's an inline code block that happens to contain an ':::note' and it confuses the MDX processor. Also the relative link used is `../ops/cache#warm-start` but the header in cache.mdx is `## Warm starting` so the slug becomes `warm-starting` after slugify. Alice: :eyes: I've seen this — some MDX remark parsers choke when you start an admonition marker inside a fenced code snippet or indented block. The fix is to ensure `:::` is on its own line and not wrapped in a code fence, or escape it. For the anchor, we either fix the link or add an explicit header id like `## Warm starting {#warm-start}`. Ben: I can take this. I'll normalize the link and move the admonition out of the code block. Assigning to me. Greg: Small option if you want minimal churn: add an explicit html id on the header in cache.mdx: `## Warm starting ` — works as a quick compatibility shim. Ben: Working on a branch now. Plan: 1) update ../ops/cache#warm-start -> ../ops/cache/#warm-starting 2) move/escape the admonition in setup.mdx so MDX parser doesn't see it inside a code fence 3) run local linkcheck. Local command: `PYTHONPATH=. python -m scripts.linkcheck docs` docs-ci: Linkcheck passed locally on Ben's branch, but CI failed because of a cached build image. Suggestion: clear Netlify cache or set `actions/cache` key bump. Ben: Pushed fix to branch `docs/linkfix-mdx-4123`. Cleared CI cache and re-ran. CI passed after cache clear. PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-docs/pull/4123 :white_check_mark: Carla: Great — can you also backport the anchor change to `release/v1.x`? We still get a few hits to that branch from legacy integrations. Ben: Will open follow-up PR to `release/v1.x` after this merges. Alice: Also leaving a tiny contributing doc update: add a note about admonitions not being inside triple-backtick blocks and a short paragraph on how anchors are slugified. Saves future debugging. Carla: Awesome. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. Closing once backport PR merges. :tada:
